target: ＊嗷＊ ＊嗷＊ 终于是我的！我从松林里打呼的女人类那里叼走小东西，拔腿就跑。老腿能跑多快就跑多快。快快回家，家在装烂东西的大桶子旁边（可是有好吃的）。 噢，小东西！ 亮亮的，像露珠！绿石头清清的，像溪水！以后去哪里都带着你。不让你离开眼睛！ 我不知道为什么，可是那股冲动现在安静了。冲动安静得像池塘。不再被推着走。不再担心（好舒服）。肌肉不再喊「走」了。它们好累。现在可以休息。终于。这副老身体可以休息了。

source:
Every time I think our marriage has dried up, somehow there’s a day that changes all that. Another Valentine’s Day in the books – dress nice, fill up on red wine and pasta at Anatra Bianca, send the babysitter home, sex, bed time. I can't sleep because it was all normal. Perfectly normal, actually. I didn’t realize how much I missed normal…

Everly loved the necklace I bought her from the pawn shop. The salesperson had no idea about its history, said it was found by some teenager in a parking lot long ago. A pendant with a green gem carved with a one-eyed woman – Everly thought I had it custom made. “Her new sigil,” she called it, her little good-luck trinket. 

I don’t know if it was the gift or the wine, but her mood was golden. Laughter and jokes and sweet conversation. When she laughs, she is the most beautiful woman in the world. It’s like, in that moment, the months… the years of gloom and struggle with her mental health disappear.
target:
每次我以为我们的婚姻已经干涸，总会有某一天，一切又不一样了。又过完一个情人节——打扮整齐，到白鸭餐厅喝红酒、吃义大利面，吃饱喝足后回家，送保母离开，做爱，上床睡觉。我却睡不着，因为这一切都太正常了。其实，是再正常不过。我以前没发现，自己竟然这么想念正常的生活……

艾芙莉很喜欢我在当铺买给她的项链。店员不知道它的来历，只说很久以前，有个青少年在停车场捡到。坠子镶着一颗绿宝石，上面刻着一名独眼女子——艾芙莉还以为我请人特制的。她说这是「她的新徽记」，是她的小幸运符。

不知道是礼物还是红酒的功劳，她的心情好得不得了。她笑着、开着玩笑，说着甜蜜的话。她笑起来，是全世界最美的女人。仿佛就在那一刻，她这几个月……这几年来的阴郁，以及与精神疾病的挣扎，都消失了。

source:
The A.N.I.S fireteam engaged in its first deployment early this morning following an anonymous tip to the Mayor’s Office of a dangerous person in Pine Hills Park. After an altercation with officers, Romina Zappa was shot fives times. She was pronounced dead when she arrived at Waldon Emergency Hospital.  

Mayor Van Eisen described the event as a tragedy, but unavoidable. “Body camera footage shows that officers acted in self defense as Romina was incoherent and charged them with a sizable knife,” Mayor Van Eisen said. “She was identified as a prime suspect in the Praetis murder,” he added, “and unfortunately her violent behavior suggests she may have done it.” 

Sheriff Buzz Snow provided a rare, voluntary statement on the incident. “I’ve arrested Romina plenty of times to know that she suffered from severe schizophrenia,” Sheriff Snow said. “She was one of us, a Piney, and she needed help, not being scared to her wits end by tactical bugaboos armed to the teeth. There weren’t a lick of fingerprints, DNA, or any evidence linking Romina to the Praetis murder. Let that go on record.”

范艾森镇长称此事是场悲剧，却无可避免。「随身摄影机画面显示，萝蜜娜当时语无伦次，手持一把大刀冲向警员，因此警员是出于自卫。」范艾森镇长表示。他补充说：「她是普雷蒂斯命案的主要嫌疑人。很遗憾，她的暴力行为显示，她很可能就是凶手。」

巴兹・史诺警长罕见地主动就此事发表声明。「我逮捕过萝蜜娜好多次，知道她患有严重的思觉失调症。」史诺警长说。「她是我们的一分子，是松林镇民。她需要的是帮助，而不是被一群武装到牙齿的战术妖魔吓得魂飞魄散。没有半枚指纹、半点 DNA，也没有任何证据能把萝蜜娜和普雷蒂斯命案扯在一起。这句话给我记清楚。」

source: We the editors of the Asbury Bulletin spotlight this open letter on July 4. News on regional and national developments will resume in the next issue. Thank you for understanding. My fellow Pinies, You knew me as Deborah Wolf, Esq., your local tax attorney. Since occupation reassignments, you know me now as Deborah the assistant community cook. To say that our lives are changing is an understatement. More accurately, we will never be the same. But some things must never change. The greatest power of our modern society is not in industry, military, academics, or technology. It’s in something we live by every day: our constitutional democracy. To lose our rights of free speech and thought means losing the heart of who we are. I look back to the American Revolutionary War hero, to our great town’s namesake, "Deathless" Nathaniel Asbury. Like us, he was surrounded by the threat of great harm and tyranny. And yet, he chose courage. He held meetings with neighbors to exchange ideas. Ideas led to action. Action spurred progress. Progress fueled unimaginable growth. Never forget, my dear neighbors, that hope is nurtured in a free and open forum. Holdfast to our little democratic values. Cherish that we can decide our path forward. If not for our sake, but for the sake of the lessons we shall pass to our children. Join me every Sunday at the Asbury High School auditorium, from noon until 2 p.m., to discuss how we can collaborate with our Mayor for a steady future in these terribly uncertain times. Your assistant community cook, Deborah Wolf
target: 本报编辑部于 7 月 4 日特别刊登这封公开信。地区及全国动态将于下期恢复报导，感谢读者体谅。 各位松林镇的乡亲： 你们原本认识的我是黛博拉・沃尔夫律师，是镇上的税务律师。职业重新分派后，你们现在认识的是社区助理厨师黛博拉。若只说我们的生活正在改变，实在太轻描淡写。更准确地说，我们再也回不到从前了。 但有些事，绝不能改变。 现代社会最强大的力量，不在工业、军事、学术或科技，而在我们每天赖以生活的事物：宪政民主。失去言论与思想自由的权利，就等于失去了我们之所以为我们的核心。 我想起美国独立战争的英雄，也是我们这座伟大城镇名字的由来——「不死」纳撒尼尔・阿斯伯里。他和我们一样，身处重大伤害与暴政的威胁之中。然而，他选择了勇气。他与邻居聚会，交流想法。想法引发行动，行动带动进步，进步促成难以想像的成长。亲爱的邻居，请永远记住：自由开放的讨论，是孕育希望的地方。 请坚守我们小小的民主价值。珍惜我们仍能决定前路的权利。即使不为自己，也要为我们将传给孩子的教诲。 每周日中午十二时至下午二时，请到阿斯伯里高中礼堂与我相聚，讨论如何与镇长合作，在这极度不安定的时局里，共同走向安稳的未来。 你们的社区助理厨师 黛博拉・沃尔夫

Mayor Alvin Van Eisen II, 

It’s plain to me that my authority as Sheriff is worth pig shit. In fact, I figure I must be the last officer to hear about new community policing matters y’all push through. Be that as it may, good folks are straining to survive this new reality and the tactical goons from your A.N.I.S. program ain’t helping. They cause harm and stir up resentment. Smashing windows in homes if they feel insulted… beating a father of three kids half to death for trying to get emergency antibiotics after dark… withholding feminine hygiene products for “favors.”  

Disgusting. These ain’t men. This ain’t policing. 

Consider this letter my official resignation as Sheriff of Asbury Pines -- not due to my old bones, but due to the fact that I refuse to enforce your so called "laws." Deputy Bryce Hawley, Officer Steve Lewis and Officer Merle Ringold have enclosed their resignations along with mine. We’ll be giving up our badges and guns at Dory’s Diner, registering for new occupations immediately, and helping Deborah Wolf keep spirits up and hopes kindled. 

Do better for your citizens, 
Rodney Snow

<size=26>The Praetis Press</size>

Hello World. Welcome to the April 20, 2052, town hall! 

This is made from the Praetis Press. We are independent. 

My kids and I made this leaflet with recycled ink from coffee grounds and movable type. Movable type is the old way of printing. It combines letters, words, and other elements into a document and then stamps out copies onto paper. 

It is slow work. We make each letter and word with baked clay, and we still need many more words. But this does not need electricity. It can grow from here and go on forever! 

My kids and I want to use this press to share good ideas, stories about progress, and bad jokes. 

Our first bad joke: Why do dogs float in water? Because they are good buoys.

Stay tuned for the next issue!
target:
<size=26>普雷蒂斯小报</size>

世界，你好。欢迎来到 2052 年 4 月 20 日的镇民大会！

这是普雷蒂斯印刷所的出版品。我们独立运作。

我和孩子们用咖啡渣回收制成的墨水，以及活字印刷，做了这张传单。活字印刷是古老的印刷方法：把字母、单字和其他元素排成文章，再印到纸上，制作副本。

这是慢工。我们用烧制的黏土制作每个字母和单字，还缺好多字。不过，这不需要电。从这里开始，就能继续发展下去，永不停歇！

我和孩子们想用这台印刷机，分享好点子、进步的故事，以及冷笑话。

我们的第一个冷笑话：为什么狗狗浮在水面上？因为牠们都是好「浮标」——英文的 buoys，听起来就像好孩子 boys。

敬请期待下一期！

哎呀……这世界到底成了什么样？可怕的战争，可怕的和平。禁酒令——根本是闹剧！镇上的小伙子和姑娘们到处找酒喝，穿着不知羞耻的衣服，喝得烂醉，跳的舞连魔鬼看了都要脸红。礼义廉耻跑哪去了？我心里毫不怀疑，眼前就是另一座所多玛与蛾摩拉！

《利未记》27:30 说：「地上所有的，无论是地上的种子，是树上的果子，十分之一是耶和华的，是归给耶和华为圣的。」

是啊，该把上帝赐给我的财富，交还给主了。只要抓准时机、运用才智，再蒙祂恩典指引，我就能买下整座镇的控制权。明天开始拟定计划……购置房产，只向那些……人及企业提供贷款与投资：
